what: A clone of the legendary Synth1 VST. One synth, bitimbral or quad-timbral, with the sounds split left and right for devices like the Circuit Tracks. 256 sounds on the device, 3,000+ in the Patch Manager, 20,000+ Synth1 sounds to find online.
